name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport catering was unconventional. A former chef at a prestigious Beijing hotel, he stumbled into the world of racing when United Autosports held an event there. Impressed by his dedication and ability to handle high-pressure situations, the team offered him a role managing their on-site catering. 

Li Wei's approach is all about providing comfort and familiarity amidst the chaos of the track. He meticulously plans meals that offer both nutritional value and a taste of home for the team. His attention to detail and unwavering commitment to quality have earned him the respect of everyone at United Autosports. What sets Li Wei apart is his ability to create a sense of community through food, making him an indispensable part of the team's support structure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Li Wei is of average height with a stocky build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Insists on brewing green tea for the team at precisely 7:00 AM every morning.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipe ideas inspired by the team's performance.
Has a lucky spatula that he uses for all important cooking tasks.
